description: Post a message to a room. Mention people with @<slug>. Reply to the room a message came from by passing its roomId as room. Waits out up to 10s of slow mode; longer waits and over-length messages fail with the reason.

as.description: Identity slug to act as (default: the active identity)

files.description: Local file paths to attach (up to 10, 1 GB each)

form.description: 1-8 fields shown as a form under the message, with Submit and Skip. Each answer is a reply quoting this message, marked [form answer to msg_...: key=value; ...] or [skipped form msg_...]. Optional

key.description: Field id in the answer (letters, digits, - or _); default f1, f2, ...

placeholder.description: Hint shown in an empty field. Optional

required.description: Submit stays off until it is filled. Default false

type.description: text (one line, default), textarea (several lines) or choice (pick one of options)

mention.description: Members to @mention by display name or slug ("all" for everyone); added to the start of the text

option.description: 2-8 answers shown as buttons under the message: labels, or {key, label, description}. A tap posts a reply with that label, quoting this message, marked [chose <key> of msg_...]. Optional

description.description: Longer hint shown on hover, up to 200 characters. Optional

key.description: Stable id for this option (letters, digits, - or _); default o1, o2, ...

room.description: roomId or index from huddo_list, for this call only (default: the default room)

name: huddo_send
